lines.x: President Bola Tinubu's administration committed N450 billion to agricultural programs and approved N1.5 trillion for banking sector recapitalisation to boost food security and lending.
A three-day sell-off erased N3 trillion from the Nigerian stock market capitalisation following profit-taking in Dangote Cement, Aradel, and major commercial banks.
The Nigerian naira closed at 1,394 per US dollar, hitting its weakest exchange level in three weeks.
Nigeria's annual stock market index gain reached roughly 60% in November following four straight monthly declines in inflation.
